description.value: The Cliff House Restaurant is a casual West Coast dining venue inside Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, paying homage to the original Cliff House built on the canyon's edge in 1889. It serves fresh local ingredients, Ocean Wise seafood, BC wines, and regional craft beer on tap, with a summer patio overlooking the park canyon and cozy indoor seating with local history. Access requires paid park admission, making this a destination experience rather than a casual drop-in stop for touring cyclists.

address.value: 3735 Capilano Road, North Vancouver, BC V7R 4J1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active, open restaurant inside Capilano Suspension Bridge Park at 3735 Capilano Road, North Vancouver. The menu page confirms vegetarian options (Black Bean & Corn Burger, Butter Paneer, Capilano Canyon Salad, Hummus & Pita, Rice Bowl). A critical concern is that the website explicitly states 'Cliff House Restaurant is located inside Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, which requires paid admission or Annual Pass use,' meaning cyclists cannot access the restaurant without paying park entry fees. No bike parking, washrooms, takeout, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website.
concerns: Access requires paid admission to Capilano Suspension Bridge Park — cyclists cannot enter the restaurant without purchasing a park ticket or holding an Annual Pass. This significantly limits utility as a casual stop.
OSM name is 'Cliff House Restaurant & Bar' but the website consistently uses 'The Cliff House Restaurant' with no 'Bar' designation in the title (though beer and wine are served).
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced exclusively from the website's contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by active website with full menu. Paid park admission barrier is a notable practical concern for cyclists but does not disqualify it from the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: No reservations accepted; seating is first come, first served.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Black Bean & Corn Burger, Butter Paneer (vegetarian variant of Butter Chicken), Capilano Canyon Salad, Hummus & Pita, and a Rice Bowl with plant-based topping options
